title: extensions/authority/0.1: the organizations whose authority levels a service reads, and the level each relayed action needs (DEC-0162)
description: The value of the authority extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/authority/0.1 in a service's well-known document, beside the actions extension (DEC-0121 AP-1), which it never changes: a reader of the actions extension pinned before DEC-0162 ignores this key. A service that reads levels declares levels; the level an action needs is keyed by the action's id in the actions extension. A reader ignores a member it does not define (a later decision adds members to this key, as DEC-0166 adds standing), so the root is open; the members it defines are closed. A checker reports an invalid value, an organization named twice and a level for an id that is not a relayed action of the actions extension as FAC-SEM-142. docs/specification/membership.md#levels.

levels.description: DEC-0162 LV-5: the organizations whose levels this service reads, each with the audience that organization's issuer registered it by as an org-membership/2 reader; the hub fetches a level holder's attestation for that audience and binds it by mem. Absent: the service reads no levels (LV-10).

actionLevels.description: DEC-0162 LV-7: the lowest level that decides this relayed action in an organization: owner for a billing act (the organization's plan, its payment method, its invoices); operator for an act no level decides (a rule proposal's approval, type rule, proposals FAC-SEM-104; an owner's settlement is no relayed action); admin for a client key's relayed twin of an instance the organization deploys (DEC-0159 CF-3: the revoking twin; issuing or rotating a member's key stays CF-3's human step on the owner's or an administrator's decision), an access grant at a gate, a spend limit (setting or changing a project's L1, a key's ceiling or an organization-wide total once one is specified), a board hold's set and lift, the move of a responder slot and a Project's listing and unlisting (project-comms), any other proposal type's approval and a credential request's decision offered as a relayed action (the operator's answers to questions 4 and 9, 2026-11-13). An action this map leaves out is decided by an architect in the call's project, by admin for a call in no project; an action whose effect is change-policy is read as admin at least, whatever this map says (the operator's answer to question 4).
